Operations reference 021/015; issuer account Nacre-38; dispatch 20262115.

This is a service summary prepared for the beneficial holder. Attendance arrangements, corporate records and account reconciliation are distinct from the voting requirements set out in the operative paragraphs.

Historical cutoff, superseded: voting instructions were due on 2 September 2026 at 10:00 UTC.

The issuer has convened its Extraordinary General Meeting; shareholders may submit proxy voting instructions through their custodian.

For this event, The voting holder is required to provide a valid power of attorney before instructions are accepted.

For this event, Shares instructed for voting are required to remain unavailable for transfer until the meeting ends.

For this event, A participating voter is required to satisfy the additional professional-investor eligibility condition.

PRELIMINARY CONDITION (superseded): For this event, Votes attached to an account are required to be cast identically because split voting is prohibited. FINAL AMENDMENT, replacing that condition: The agent confirms that a restriction on split voting does not apply to this event.

PRELIMINARY CONDITION (superseded): For this event, The voting investor is required to recall loaned securities before exercising voting rights. FINAL AMENDMENT, replacing that condition: The agent confirms that recall of securities on loan does not apply to this event.

FINAL AMENDMENT: Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 10 October 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

Security descriptions may be abbreviated in account statements. The issuer legal name remains unchanged.
Regards, Operations
